root_cause: An unchanged repaint revoked an already-completed force-warning presentation. draw_panel unconditionally changed Confirmable→Hidden→Drawn; if a fresh Enter arrived during that repaint, tui.rs:918 skipped after_draw because input was queued, so panel_event rejected that legitimate confirmation.
causal_evidence: failure.ansi starts with the complete stale-force-needs-reconfirmation.ansi capture. Its subsequent recorded frame sequence is: fresh complete force warning for newest-owner, a completed zero-cell-diff redraw, then 'Force confirmation blocked'. Ratatui's installed backend/Terminal source establishes the reset/show-cursor/cursor-position sequence as a completed draw delimiter.

The test sends only the fresh prefix action and one Enter during this interval (native.rs:745-748). A queued Enter at the first warning's after_draw check would be consumed before another redraw; the intervening no-op frame identifies the later repaint demotion.
The final screen has the complete warning and unchanged newest-owner, excluding stale-observation rejection and clipped-warning presentation as this failure's cause.
